name: Limit Kitchen & Bar
description: East Lansing Karaoke is a vibrant karaoke venue known for its private rooms and friendly atmosphere. Guests praise the variety of song choices, the clean and well-maintained environment, and the fun, relaxed vibe. The venue offers a full bar and food options, making it ideal for both casual singing nights and private celebrations. Its late hours and welcoming staff make it a popular spot for locals seeking entertainment and good times.
